name: claude-mods
description: Free, open mods for Claude Code. Install any of them with one command.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Live progress: model, tokens, cost, timer and to-do bar above the prompt, a status line, and an Agents panel (/savvy).

plugins.name: turn-receipt
plugins.description: An itemized receipt for every job: time and cost per agent, calls and time per tool, slowest step, biggest read, files changed, cache hit. /receipt, /receipt copy.
